intuition: A root-to-leaf path qualifies when its node values sum to targetSum and it ends at a node with no children.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every root-to-leaf path, store its values, and sum each completed path.

optimal.approach: Subtract each visited node value from the remaining target and recurse until a leaf is reached.

edge_cases: A matching sum at an internal node is not enough.
Negative values are allowed and cannot be pruned by sum size.
An empty tree has no qualifying path.
